<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
from collections import Counter
def diff_summary(t):
    ab=t.before_frame.ascii.split('\n'); aa=t.after_frame.ascii.split('\n')
    cnt=Counter()
    for r in range(64):
        for c in range(64):
            if ab[r][c]!=aa[r][c]: cnt[(ab[r][c],aa[r][c])]+=1
    return dict(cnt)
def bboxes():
    out=[]
    for n in current_frame.segmentation['nodes']:
        if n['color'] in ('B','c') and n['pixels']>20:
            b=n['boundary']; rows=[p[0] for p in b]; cols=[p[1] for p in b]
            out.append((n['color'], min(rows), min(cols), max(rows), max(cols)))
    return out
print("before:", bboxes())
res = action(['LEFT'])
print("LEFT (div off):", diff_summary(last_transition))
print("after:", bboxes())
res = action(['RIGHT'])
print("RIGHT (div off):", diff_summary(last_transition))
print("after:", bboxes())
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
